# Parry — AI procurement platform (private beta)

## What is Parry?
Parry is an AI procurement platform. It reads a company's contracts, invoices, and supplier email threads, extracts the commercial terms, and catches overbilling and renewals before they cost money.

## Status
Parry is in private beta with a small group of enterprise procurement and finance teams. A new public site is in progress.

## Who is Parry for?
Procurement and finance teams at companies managing large supplier portfolios.

## Google user data
